issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

key.description: A cached instance of native java Key class.

algorithm.description: The {@link CryptoKeyAlgorithm algorithm} of the key.

pkcs.description:
Supported {@link PublicKeyCryptographyStandards pubic key cryptography standard} of the key.
Now {@link CryptoPrivateKey CryptoPrivateKey} supports both PKCS1 and PKCS8 standards while
{@link CryptoPublicKey CryptoPublicKey} only support PKCS8

jwtAlgorithm.description: The algorithm used to verify jwt tokens using the key pair.

content.description:
The string representation of the key in PEM extension. The key could either be constructed with this content field
populated or sourcing from the specified the {@link fileUrl} pointing to the key file in PEM extension.

fileUrl.description:
The url of the file storing the key in PEM extension on a Cloud FileSystem (ex: {@link S3 Se} or
{@link AzureFileSystem AzureFileSystem}). The url should contains scheme (i.e. file-system) and fully qualified encoded path.

signAlgorithm.description:
The {@link CryptoSignatureAlgorithm} the keys will be used for.
This is for use with the java.security.signature library

keyLength.description:
Key size in bits, what this represents depends on the public key crypto scheme used.
For example, for RSA, this is the bit-length of the modulus.

daysValid.description: Number of days the keys are valid since the key was generated

title: Type to represent a an app's private key, which is used to sign tokens.
name: App.PrivateKey
